Problem Statement
Write a program to analyze an algorithm's efficiency based on the number of operations performed and the amount of memory used.
Description
Read two integers representing the number of operations and memory units used. Calculate:
Total resource usage (operations + memory)
Difference between operations and memory
Product of operations and memory
Efficiency score (operations ÷ memory)
Display the results in the specified format.
Sample Input
100
20
Sample Output
Total Usage: 120
Difference: 80
Product: 2000
Efficiency Score: 5
